title: Activation succession and fallback charter (working)
content:
Purpose:
This working charter defines a cross-functional ceremony and operational pattern for activation succession (how we graduate exposure from micro cohorts to full rollouts) and automated/semiautomated fallback behavior for canaries and A/B experiments. Focus is production-first: protect latency SLOs, cost budgets, and customer-visible correctness while enabling safe progressive exposure for LLM features.

Audience:
- Product managers driving feature exposure
- Eng leads (frontend, backend, serving-runtime)
- Observability/SRE oncall and oncall rotation owners
- Solutions & SEs who enable customer canaries on Dedicated/Private

High-level goals:
- Single source of truth for activation succession steps and ownership for each stage
- Reusable, testable fallback primitives (traffic cut, model-variant fallback, degrade-to-cache, static-response stub)
- Failure-mode-driven rollback criteria with clear metric thresholds and test harnesses for simulation before real traffic
- Minimal blast radius with automated quarantine for high-severity drift (safety or latency/cost shock)
- Runbooks and small-batch simulation scripts so each rollout is rehearsed pre-activation

Ceremony phases (operational glossary):
1) Greenroom (pre-activation rehearsal)
   - Stakeholders: PM, Feature Eng, Serving Eng, Observability lead, SE
   - Activities: run synthetic-sim simulation with 10k synthetics across slices; run chaos-latency test; smoke integration with model variant locks
   - Artifacts: rehearsal report, synthetic traffic seed id, cost simulation snapshot

2) Micro-activation (0.1% -> 1% slices depending on risk profile)
   - Owner: Feature Eng lead
   - Controls: feature flag gating, traffic-slab isolation, per-slice telemetry retention for 48h
   - Signals monitored: 95p latency, 99p latency, error-rate, hallucination-rate (sampled eval), token-cost-per-request, downstream error cascade (HTTP 5xx to partners)

3) Staged-scaling (1% -> 10% -> 30%)
   - Progressive vector: double-exposure every 12–24 hours if signals green
   - Automated checkpoint: every step triggers a validation job that runs a holdout prompt-set evaluation and compares quality metrics to baseline (A/B DP test)

4) Ramp-to-opt-in/full exposure
   - Governance: final ops signoff + runbook closure notes

Fallback patterns (primitive list):
- TrafficCut: immediate drop-to-0 for suspect slice(s) via coordinated FF toggle and routing policy (fast path for SRE)
- ModelVariantFallback: route to fallback model variant (smaller quantized or older-but-safe) with incremental traffic split (90/10) before full switch
- DegradeToCache: for latency spikes, enable prefix/KV cached stub to maintain user experience while under investigation
- StaticSafetyStub: return deterministic safe response for problematic prompt classes (last resort for safety incidents)

Automated gating heuristics (first-draft thresholds):
- Latency: 95p > 300ms above baseline for 5m sliding window -> warn; 95p > 500ms above baseline for 10m -> trigger partial TrafficCut
- Cost: token-cost-per-request uplift > 2x baseline for 1h with >10% traffic -> warn; >3x -> traffic quarantine
- Quality: automated reranker/metric drift (BLEU/ROUGE surrogate or embedding-stability delta) p-value < 0.01 over holdout -> pause scaling
- Safety: flagged content rate > 0.05% absolute or 3x baseline in sampled eval -> immediate canary halt and stakeholder escalation

Escalation playbook (roles & comms):
- Triage owner (first responder): Oncall SRE (page via PagerDuty)
- Secondary: Serving runtime eng lead (slack: #serving-oncall)
- Notify: PM and Product Ops (email/async slack thread)
- Exec: if customer-impacting with SLAs breached -> Alert oncall director + CS L1 (template in linked_artifacts)

Simulation & testing checklist (must be green before Greenroom signoff):
- Synthetic workload run (script id: sim/activation/2026-03) – run at expected QPS and 2x expected QPS
- Latency chaos: inject 200ms tail to disk IO and validate DegradeToCache triggers from automation pipeline
- Model fallback rehearsal: simulate model variant failure and validate routing switches in sandbox
- Recovery drill: re-enable normal traffic after mock incident and verify metrics return within 2x baseline in 30 minutes

Small-batch experimental guidance (for A/B and rerankers):
- Prefer micro-slice orthogonalization: slice by cohort feature (device type, locale, first-time users) to reduce contamination
- Use holdout baseline (5–10% always) to measure long-tail drift and unseen failure classes
- Lock experiment parameters (seed prompts, temperature, top_p) in release branch and attach to rollout artifact

Operational templates and quick actions (copy these into runtime automation):
- Fast rollback CLI: rwdctl rollout revert --slice-id $SLICE --reason \"$ISSUE\" --notify
- Canary promote script: rwdctl rollout promote --slice $SLICE --to 10pct --validate-job $JOB_ID
- Quarantine invocation: POST /ops/quarantine {slice, trigger, metric_snapshot_url} -> triggers feature flag off and model-variant fallback

Open questions & TODOs (short):
- Who owns runbook maintenance long term? suggestion: rotational steward between product-console and eng-sre
- How do we instrument hallucination-rate reliably at scale? current detectors are flaky; need eval harness improvements
- Define SLA tiers for Dedicated vs Hosted for automatic fallback behaviors (Dedicated customers may prefer slower automation)
- Add integration tests that exercise StaticSafetyStub in CI; blocker: small infra dependency on private-deploy test infra

Notes to self / meeting crumbs:
- Claire: ask Security about PII-hit thresholds for quarantines (Slack thread #security-ops 2026-02-11)
- Omar: draft PR to add telemetry tags token_cost_delta and model_variant_origin
- Marco: schedule small tabletop drill Mar 19 (invite SRE/product/engineers)

Appendix (quick links and snippets):
- Rehearsal script: github.com/redwood-inference/ops-sims/blob/main/activation_rehearsal.py
- Linear: EX-541 (fallback-autotrigger design)
- Slack channels: #rollout-stewards, #serving-oncall, #product-activation

End of working charter. Intend to convert to formal playbook after two successful rehearsals.

----

Unresolved/stream-of-consciousness notes (warts included):
- Want a "succession manifest" JSON that encodes the stage sequence and required approvals; will prototype today — could be used to drive UI in Console
- Consider adding an "opt-in escape hatch" for customers on Dedicated so CS can manually override automation on customer-critical flows
- How do we record manual overrides so postmortem can see operator actions? add audit trail schema to rollout metadata
